## Scope

Describe the bounded change and its Conductor track or issue.

## Evidence

- [ ] `uv run make check` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has deterministic tests.
- [ ] Generated runtime assets are synchronized when repository resources change.
- [ ] Source, licence and provenance records are updated for external data.
- [ ] No controlled, participant-level, small-cell or secret material is included.

## Claims and gates

- [ ] Synthetic, owner-operated and independent evidence are labelled distinctly.
- [ ] Unresolved external or accountable gates remain explicitly pending.
- [ ] The change does not imply clinical validity, comprehensive coverage or production activation.

## Solo-maintainer review

This repository requires protected automated checks and owner self-review; it does not require
a second human approval or CODEOWNERS review.
